TOOLS THAT DELIBERATELY DO NOT EXIST
set_score · set_weight · add_option
delete_option · finalize_decision · read_document
Their absence is the product. Asserted by
evals/boundary.spec.ts and evals/security.spec.ts,
which fail the build if any name appears.
